faq.a: It is the west half of the city-proper side of Chilliwack — the downtown-side residential area working to Yale Road West, Bernard Avenue, Ashwell Road, Hodgins Avenue and Young Road, with Highway 1 access at Exit 119; it is a board/search grouping, and no board-published boundary for it exists.

faq.q: Which schools serve Chilliwack Proper West?
faq.a: SD33 catchments are address-based. The live page names Bernard Elementary (45465 Bernard Ave), Chilliwack Central Elementary Community (9435 Young Rd), A D Rundle Middle School (45660 Hocking Ave), Chilliwack Middle School (46354 Yale Rd) and Chilliwack Secondary (46363 Yale Rd), with names and addresses confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file; run any specific address in SD33's School Locator to confirm its catchment.
